main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: The material world is an illusion of the Demiurge
header_desc: The union between science and spirituality occurs when we understand that the Gnostic gospels, written nearly two thousand years ago, hold the key to one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity. The EGO has mass and creates the tempo-material illusion; to counteract it, the cosmos offers us a Universal Consciousness, timeless and spaceless: the ONE, whose guidance—followed with the heart of Sophia—allows us to free ourselves from the prison of Yaldabaoth
left_title: From the psyche 🧠 material ┻ to the divine ❤️ pneuma ✝️
left_body: In general relativity, matter tells space-time how to curve, and space-time tells matter how to move. Similarly, the ego has mass and exerts its own gravity: its density distorts your inner fabric and weaves the temporal and material illusion ┻ of the psyche 🧠. Thus, only through the wisdom of Sophia is it possible to understand that the statement 'the Father and I are one' is a call to dissolve the 'false self' to return to the kingdom of pure light where the Invisible Father dwells: the timeless and divine ✝️ reality of the pneuma ❤️.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end, but a transformation frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere, our pneuma resides in the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: Human consciousness manifests itself through two fundamental states: the spiritual |UNO⟩ (represented by Pistis Sophia and associated with the right hemisphere ❤️) and the material |EGO⟩ (represented by the Demiurge Yaldabaoth and associated with the left hemisphere 🧠). This reveals that we possess free will of perception linked to the cosmos, which can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨UNO|EGO⟩.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force pulls us towards a place where: <q>war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength</q> (1984).
final_quote: The Christian cross is a sacred symbol capable of healing the wounds of the heart and, at the same time, freeing us from illusion. Only when the Northern Eagle and the Southern Condor fly together in the same sky will Mother Earth awaken and humanity heal
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The Flight of Science and Spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and framework of integration: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and mind). The call for balance to initiate evolutionary awakening and transcend duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and Temporal Illusion (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity vs. Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, Einstein's breakdown of simultaneity and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The conceptual assembly Faggin--Segarra: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside of space-time, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_desc: The Nag Hammadi find (1945) and Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as a home but as a prison of the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to establish a religion of dogmas but to liberate the inner spark from the prison of the Demiurge through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Kingdom of Light and the Prison of the Demiurge (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The Demiurge Yaldabaoth—also known as the great architect of matter—is the creator of the sensible world, an egocentric god ignorant of true divinity. On the other hand, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, waiting for the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and Universal Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as a cognitive prison of the ego, contrasted with the revolutionary message of Jesus that dismantles the system of imperial slavery.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: In the end, the great paradox boils down to this: in the vastness of the cosmos—with its more than two trillion galaxies—it is there that the phrase of Jesus resonates most powerfully: 'The Father and I are one.' Could there be a hidden message regarding the deep bond between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: <q>The idea that God is a white man, larger than normal, with a flowing beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one understands the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then such a God clearly exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it makes little sense to pray to the law of gravity</q>
